elements.label: Salesforce cloud logo (cloud plus wordmark, moving as one unit)

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: The onset at ~0.78s is one of a regular series of broadband onsets (~0.1, 0.35, 0.55, 0.8, 1.05, 1.3s...) in the music bed; nothing visual happens at that moment (logo is already decelerating). Not a reverse swoosh.

pattern.description: Opening logo glides in from right of centre to the centre of a deep purple gradient while fading from translucent to full opacity, decelerating into a soft settle.
pattern.why_premium: A single long, decelerating glide (no bounce, no scale pop) gives the brand mark a calm, confident entrance; the opacity ramp running together with the slide hides the start of the motion so the logo seems to emerge from the background.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.logo', {x: 300, opacity: 0.2}, {x: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 1.1, ease: 'power3.out'}) - x and opacity on one tween, no stagger; the cloud and wordmark are a single group.
build_hint.remotion: const p = interpolate(frame, [0, 33], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); translateX = (1 - p) * 300; opacity = 0.2 + 0.8 * p. A critically damped spring ({damping: 200, stiffness: 60}) is an alternative for x.

notes: Wordmark (b03) moves with the cloud and is not listed separately; b02 is a union region including the start position. Logo appears roughly constant in size; whole-frame scale 1.13 reflects the partial-frame change, not a camera move.
